opened.times: Opened {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
opened.last: Opened {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}, last {last}
copy.label: Copy the link
copy.failed: Could not copy. Select the link instead.
dialog.title: {kind, select, flight {Share this flight} sighting {Share this sighting} aircraft {Share this aircraft} other {Share your whole log}}
dialog.owner: Its pages name you “{owner}”, as in “{owner} has flown 12 flights”. Change it under Account in Settings.
dialog.shared: Anyone with this link can open it, without signing in, until you stop sharing it. It shows your log as it is now.
dialog.new: {kind, select, flight {Anyone with the link can see this flight, notes and photo links included.} sighting {Anyone with the link can see this sighting, notes and photo links included.} aircraft {Anyone with the link can see this aircraft and your flights and sightings of it, notes and photo links included.} other {Anyone with the link can see your whole log, notes and photo links included.}} Ticket numbers and booking references are never shared.
stop.confirm: {kind, select, flight {Stop sharing this flight?} sighting {Stop sharing this sighting?} aircraft {Stop sharing this aircraft?} other {Stop sharing your whole log?}} The link stops working at once, for everyone who has it.
stop.confirmNamed: Stop sharing {title}? The link stops working at once, for everyone who has it.
stopAll.confirm: Stop all {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}}? They stop working at once, for everyone who has them.
stopAll.done: {count, plural, one {# link was} other {# links were}} stopped.
title: Shared links
needStandard: Share links need Standard mode, where Touchdown's server keeps a key to your Google Drive so a link works while you are offline.
count: You have {count, plural, one {# shared link} other {# shared links}}.
intro: Anyone with a link can open it, without signing in. A link shows your log as it is now and works until you stop it. Ticket numbers and booking references are never shared.
broken: Your links are not available right now: the key to your Google Drive no longer works. <link>Connect Google Drive again in Settings</link>.
empty: No shared links. Share a flight, a sighting or an aircraft from its page, or your whole log from here.
links.flightGone: A flight no longer in your log
links.sightingGone: A sighting no longer in your log
links.aircraftGone: An aircraft no longer in your log
links.gone: the link says it is no longer shared
